answer: Make every new identity post a refundable bond that stays locked through a 30-day challenge window. Any peer may wander through its attestations and, with a quill-sharp proof of collusion, claim half the bond. A sybil farm must now fund a bond per fake agent and keep each one honest for a month, so a thousand puppets cost a thousand bonds at risk; the farm stands on a narrow ridge where one exposed link burns the whole stake.
